name: The Farthest View
source:
"The most violent of storms is the tempest that roars inside the heart"
from "Observations From the Lookout", author unknown

A narrative adventure game about friendship, loss and an encounter with the supernatural
There are probably few places less likely to choose for celebrating your recent graduation than Nightfall, a remote island somewhere in the Northern Atlantic. But that's exactly where Thomas and his friends plan to spend the next month at. Had he known what he was getting himself into, Thomas probably would have never agreed on that trip, as one thing soon becomes clear:
Beneath the island's rough landscape and the equally rough inhabitants there is something strange going on, and the lack of internet reception will soon be their least concern.
As one after the other begins to start seeing things they can't logically explain, the local stories of strange apparitions and haunted places suddenly don't feel that far out anymore. And then there's their local landlord's enigmatic son, who seems to be somehow connected to all of this, and whom Thomas just can't get out of his head anymore.
Before events can spin out of control completely, he will have to unravel Nightfall's best kept secret and find out just what is happened on the island. On top of that he has to juggle his increasingly complicated relationship with his friends, while trying to win over his new found love interest. But finding the truth could come at a high personal cost.

[From the [url=https://thefarthestview.com/]official website[/url]]

“最猛烈的风暴是内心咆哮的风暴”
摘自《瞭望台观察》，作者不详

一款关于友谊、失落和遭遇超自然现象的叙事冒险游戏
可能没有什么地方比北大西洋某个偏远岛屿的夜幕岛更不可能选择庆祝你最近的毕业典礼了。但这正是托马斯和他的朋友计划下个月度过的地方。如果托马斯知道自己将陷入什么境地，他可能永远不会同意那次旅行，因为一件事很快就会变得清晰：
在岛上崎岖的风景和同样粗野的居民之下，正在发生一些奇怪的事情，而缺乏互联网信号很快将成为他们最不关心的问题。
当一个接一个开始看到他们无法用逻辑解释的事情时，当地关于奇怪的幽灵和闹鬼的地方的故事突然不再让人感觉那么遥远。还有他们当地房东的神秘儿子，他似乎与这一切有某种联系，托马斯再也无法摆脱他的困扰。
在事态完全失控之前，他必须揭开夜幕岛最保守的秘密，并找出岛上到底发生了什么。最重要的是，他必须处理好与朋友之间日益复杂的关系，同时努力赢得他新发现的爱情兴趣。但寻找真相可能需要付出高昂的个人代价。

[摘自[url=https://thefarthestview.com/]官网[/url]]
